description:
Tony Robbins introduces America.gov, a new federal platform designed to make government services easier to access from one place.
The September 2026 executive order directs America.gov to become a unified entry point for covered federal services, with additional transactions and agency integrations rolling out over time. The project builds on the White House’s America by Design initiative and National Design Studio. The White House
In this clip, Tony is joined by Joe Gebbia, U.S. Chief Design Officer and Airbnb co-founder, to demonstrate the new experience.

#TonyRobbins #AmericaGov #GovernmentServices #JoeGebbia #Innovation
fulltitle: Tony Robbins Introduces the New America.gov
